text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - OOM cascade on gpu-pool-usw2-17. Auto-evicts firing, multiple containers restarted by orchestrator. Creating incident thread.

ops-rotation: I'm on it, collecting node dumps and recent deploys.

jia: quick snapshot - I can see repeated CUDA driver resets + 'CUDNN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR' in the runtime logs. Backtrace points at paged-attn allocator paths around kv_paged_allocator::alloc.

eli: customer-ops: seeing elevated 5xx rate on embeddings and chat endpoints in us-west. P50 latency jumped 50ms -> ~700ms, p95 degraded. Several tenants reporting failed requests.

samir: any recent rollout to those nodes?

morgan: no platform rollout in the last 6h. There was a model catalog update earlier but that should be orthogonal.

ops-rotation: attaching excerpt from node log:
```
[2026-03-17T03:12:18Z] runtime ERROR: allocator.cpp:482 oom when allocating 2097152 bytes
[2026-03-17T03:12:18Z] runtime ERROR: paged_attn: free_pages=312, reserved_pages=0, slab_free=1024
[2026-03-17T03:12:19Z] kernel WARN: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1e.0): 91, PID 22345 in process runtime
[2026-03-17T03:12:20Z] runtime INFO: evict triggered for key-range kv-embed-
```

jia: digging more — memory accounting shows a slow steady leak in 'kv-slot' allocations: ~1.3MB/min per node. After ~7-9 hours we hit slab exhaustion and then OOM on allocation hotpath.

samir: suggests fragmentation, not a single large leak. Small objects not being coalesced. Are eviction hooks running?

morgan: eviction is running but ineffective: freed pages are not being returned to the slab manager due to a race in the page recycle path (suspect in paged-attn compact path).

ops-rotation: mitigation plan (immediate):
- bump kv-slab-evict-threshold from 0.65 -> 0.8 on affected pool (runtime flag)
- schedule rolling restart of containers on gpu-pool-usw2-17 to force heap reclamation (do 2 at a time)
- run one-off slab-compact job to defragment resident pages: `./tools/kv-compact --pool=usw2-17 --concurrency=4`

jia: enqueueing the compact job now. If we can get slab free back to healthy, evicts should hold until we get a proper fix.

eli: customer-ops: notifying impacted customers in us-west1 about degraded performance and that we're mitigating. ETA for first stabilization ~20-30m.

oncall (samir): I'll take nightwatch for this. Handoff to me if it persists after restarts.

ops-rotation: rolling restart started - 2 containers restarted (worker-12, worker-13). Observed immediate drop in 503s but p95 still high.

jia: compact job ran, reclaimed ~1.2GB across the pool, slab_free up ~18%. Fragmentation metric (slab-porosity) reduced from 0.24 -> 0.11.

morgan: great. Monitor telemetry: token throughput vs. slab usage.

eli: customer-ops: initial customer acknowledgements - some continue to see retries but errors reduced. Sending another update.

samir: still seeing occasional CUDA resets on node gpu-pool-usw2-17-5. I'm isolating that host and migrating active jobs off it.

ops-rotation: isolated host, migrating tasks, node will be reprovisioned.

jia: short-term root cause hypothesis: page-recycle race in paged-attn compact path that prevents proper coalescing, causing gradual slab porosity -> fragmentation and eventual OOM under normal traffic. CUDA resets are a downstream symptom when the runtime hits allocator error during kernel prep.

morgan: next steps (post-stabilize):
- create reproducible test in eng-runtime with controlled alloc/free churn to stress paged-attn compact path
- add additional metrics around small-page accounting and per-slab fragmentation
- small patch to introduce a conservative fallback that forces page reclamation on repeated alloc failures
- schedule a canary rollout of patched runtime to a single pool

ops-rotation: customer impact summary for pager: ~8 tenants in us-west saw elevated 5xx between 03:10-04:05 UTC, estimated 2-10% increased error rate for embeddings. No data loss.

eli: tagging customer success for follow-up on support tickets.

samir: handing off ongoing watch to @samir (night rotation). If slab_free < 10% again, escalate to eng-runtime paging oncall.

incident-bot: incident updated - status: mitigated (partial). Actions logged, owner=jia, severity downgraded to SEV3.

morgan: assigning postmortem owner to jia. Please include reproducer, timeline, and mitigation runbook.

jia: acknowledged. I'll open the incident doc and link once created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1799123456-kv-cache-snowdrift

customer-ops: customers notified, will coordinate follow-up messages when root cause is known.

samir: leaving a short-run runbook note on the pool: if slab_free drops below 12% -> run `kv-compact` and schedule rolling restarts, escalate if compact reclaims <500MB in 10m.

morgan: thanks everyone. :white_check_mark: logging done and tagging eng-runtime for a deep dive tomorrow.

ops-rotation: closing thread for now, reopen if regressions.
